The craziest part of meth addiction is how even when you've been to the depths of hell and back through stim psychosis and somehow manage to get clean, just thinking about the rush of a fat shot makes your whole brain and body crave it. I generally support ending the war on drugs, and there's a lot of drugs that I believe are fear mongered way too much - but meth is not one of them. The way it hijacks your brain is unlike anything else. It's so incredibly powerful that even as your body is literally starving and deteriorating worse and worse every day you won't want to stop. Even now on sobriety attempt number 3, if you put a loaded rig in front of me I'd probably take that shit without even thinking because the brain and body never truly forgets that insane euphoria. Unfortunately it doesn't last, and it doesn't take very long for the neurotoxic effects to catch up to a person. Last time I went to rehab I was 79lbs and 100% convinced the meth bugs under my skin were real. I could see them and feel them and I was convinced the doctors were lying and just hated me because I was a junky. Eventually with sobriety the meth bugs go away, but I've quit 3 times now and every time towards the end the psychosis is the exact fucking same, and yet it never feels any less real or terrifying. The euphoria at the beginning of a relapse is also always more amazing than I remember and tricks me into forgetting about how horribly it ends and makes me want to believe that this time I can handle it and this time I'll be able to control it, but I never do. Hopefully this time quitting sticks, but I've learned never to promise my friends or family when I get off it that I'll stay off it forever because if I start even once im gone for at least 6 months. I only stop because it leaves me homeless, starving, isolated, and hallucinating with paranoia in a living nightmare. I only stop because I know if I die I can't keep using more. It's fucked. The only way I can even convince myself to get sober when I'm actively using is to lie to myself and tell myself that I'm not actually quitting, I'm just taking a t break. If I tell myself I'm quitting forever I just can't because the thought of living without ever experiencing that rush again makes death seem like a better option, but telling myself I'm just going to wait instead is the only way I can even get off of it long enough to think about actually quitting. What's crazy is how quickly you lose your morals in pursuit of more too. You tell yourself you'd never do x or cross y line but then you already spent all your money, you're homeless, you've burnt all your bridges and you still want more so you're leading on people for free shots and doing them in public restrooms with a needle you've already used 3 times not even giving a fuck if it's obvious that you're tweaking to everyone who just watched you leave the bathroom after spending 20 minutes in there without even flushing.
